svg.title: Удержание таза с пятками на фитболе — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Exactly ONE centered full-body static posture. Supine hip bridge hold with both heels elevated atop the SAME large round exercise stability ball, feet side by side, toes point slightly up, knees modestly bent. Side three-quarter view clearly shows both heels contact the ball. Head, shoulder blades and arms rest on floor; hips raised, shoulders through hips toward knees form a clean long line without arched low back. Ball contacts floor, both heels supported at top of ball. One still position, no bent-knee curl sequence, no bench or box or weights. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
